$comment: The market eval's floors (README.md, Floors). Scores are pass counts and only go up; speed ceilings are median ms and only go down. Measured on CI's own runner: the market-floors workflow runs the eval on 3 runners and check.mjs --raise takes the worst. A median fails when it is more than tolerance_pct over its ceiling, because medians of 9 moved about 7% between runners (74 to 79 ms click on 2026-11-18). A change that lowers anything here (a raised tolerance included) or in cli/test/dom-bench/floor.json fails CI unless the pull request has the floor-lowered label.

localOnly.rivals: Playwright MCP, agent-browser and browse run by hand (evals/market/rivals): CI scores Local Studio only and never installs third-party tools.
localOnly.domBenchWallTime: dom-bench's per-case wall time (run.mjs --time): a shared runner's clock swings several fold per case; CI gates its tool calls instead, and the speed medians above gate wall time.

measured.rule: worst of 3 runs; a score only goes up and a ceiling only goes down
